Picton and D.
On the same evening we had several Club handicap events and these resulted as under:— 100 Yards (under 19)—Heat 1, D.
The Surrey Junior events were held at Motspur Park track on June 3rd and Dave Marshall did a fine double when winning the 100 and 220 yards finals.

In the Junior events, Dave Marshall was second in the 220 yards and here again we were last of the six competing clubs. The bright spot of the meeting was Harry Churcher's win in the 2 miles walk with D.

Dave Marshall, who is also a member of our own club, won both sprint events for the W.M.S. and they also won the 880 yards and Mile. Bob Wolton won the 440 yards for us and this was our only win of the evening.

The junior 220 was run on similar lines and once again Belgrave had the two winners in Dave Marshall and Alan Law. Len Herbert and Bill Lucas had a nice comfortable run in the 1 mile and came in together, but Bill was running for his second claim club, Redhill, and so we shared points in this event.

Frank Kemp made a double of it by winning the 220 yards Junior race, beating Dave Marshall, who is the Surrey champion at this distance. Alan Sexton was defending his 220 yards senior title, but owing to his service in the R.A.F. was not up to last year's form and was beaten into second place by D.
“Ginger” Newell, who was our first man home in the recent Southern Junior c.c. race, finished second in his Corps' cross-country championship, and Doug Briggs was tenth in the same race. D.
At the Saturday fixture we were pleased to see Dave Marshall, our old Junior sprint champion, make a welcome reappearance, and he won the 100 yds., with T.
Frank has now had three Surrey Junior champions through his hands, the other two being Alan Sexton and Dave Marshall. Ron Linstead was 4th in the 1 mile and C.
